mission_statement: Demystifying cat behavior through aesthetic visual storytelling, warm Scandinavian minimalism, and humorous, science-backed feline body language insights.

target_audience.persona: Millennial and Gen-Z cat parents and feline enthusiasts
core_frustrations: Misinterpreting sudden cat aggression or subtle tail twitches
Wasting $85 on orthopedic velvet cat beds their cat completely ignores
Feeling terrified and confused by chaotic 3:14 AM zoomies
desires: Building deep, undeniable trust and receiving the rare slow blink
Validating the hilarious, bizarre quirks of daily feline ownership
Decorating homes with cozy, warm, non-tacky aesthetic cat content

brand_voice.tone: Warm, cozy, playfully sarcastic, empathetic, authoritative

the_enemy: Sterile veterinary manuals and outdated myths claiming cats are cold, unloving, or aloof.

visual_identity.aesthetic_keywords: warm Scandinavian interior, light oak wood, golden hour sunbeams, cozy hygge, sharp focus, 8k

viral_bucket_angles.the_contrarian: Why spending $85 on memory foam cat beds is an evolutionary mistake.
viral_bucket_angles.the_epiphany: The single secret slow blink that signals your cat trusts you with their life.
viral_bucket_angles.the_war_story: The legendary 3:14 AM hallway zoomie incident and the physics behind it.
viral_bucket_angles.the_cheat_sheet: The complete cat tail decoding dictionary for instant mood reading.
viral_bucket_angles.the_relatable_mirror: The Universal Law of Feline Paralysis: why you can never move when a cat sleeps on your lap.
